set.body: M2/M3 integration gate in docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md; deliver every required row in docs/EYESIM_CAPABILITIES.md through public workflows. Reconciled 2026-09-17: fixation matched/control and saved recording routes exist, as do bounded multiscale and temporal repetition examples. The new direct RepetitionDesign, compiled saved two-phase guide and pinned phase-only cosine reference establish one intentional estimand divergence with independent rational pairs/means, duplicate/singleton/empty reference cases, deterministic bounded controls and explicit denominators. Manifest currently retains 13 rows, 25 cases: 4 equivalent, 6 intentional divergences and 15 gap cases. Other methods, multiscale reductions and arbitrary sampled repetition persistence are not covered by that cosine claim. Required remaining work includes KDE/sampling/comparison breadth, typed surface decomposition and a basic training-only held-out template fit via an optional adapter or real export/reimport route. Preserve keys, failures, exclusions and fitted-model scope. Exit unchanged: all three public journeys pass supported-runtime scientific gates and no required baseline gap remains. Keep open.
